page.overview:
What is Anzellan Starship?

The Anzellan Starship was a starship used by the Anzellan Droidsmiths Minch, Keeto, Bai, and Clang to travel to Adelphi Base on the planet Adelphi in the New Republic Era. At some point, the three Anzellan Droidsmiths were joined by the foundling Din Grogu to rescue his father Din Djarin and Minch from The Twins on Nal Hutta.
